captures.name: legacy-540p-tilted
captures.note: older phone: soft, noisy, barrel distortion, glare gradient; lane K optional

captures.name: soft-480p-blur1.9
captures.note: out of focus 480p; lane K must not be reported unless correct

captures.name: small-480p
captures.note: low-end preview resolution and soft focus; lane K must not be reported unless correct

captures.name: overexposed-540p
captures.note: auto-exposure blows the tiles out three-fold; only the normalised tile read gets P and K

captures.name: veiled-720p
captures.note: older phone in a bright room: reflections lift the black level by half the lit level

captures.name: shadow-band-540p
captures.note: a band across the middle of the code in shadow (30 % light); finder levels cannot describe it

captures.name: hidden-corner-540p
captures.note: a thumb covers the bottom-left blossom; the fourth corner is inferred from the other three

captures.name: cut-corner-720p
captures.note: held too close: one corner of the code is outside the frame and is inferred

tracks.name: steady-hand-540p
tracks.note: the next analysed frame after a small hand movement; tracking reuses the pose

tracks.name: thumb-arrives-540p
tracks.note: a thumb covers the top-right blossom between two frames; tracking infers it

merges.name: noisy-480p
merges.note: a soft 480p camera in dim light: sensor noise costs every capture lane K; the four averaged read it

merges.name: banded-480p
merges.note: deep display banding with a new phase in every capture: each reads only lane D; the three averaged read lane P

mixed_merges.name: mixed-frames-480p
mixed_merges.note: the rings show frame 23 and the tile field frame 24 (a capture the frame change tore): the merge reads lane P of frame 24, which a session must not offer for frame 23
